elements.text: Chandrayaan-3 terrain reconstruction  |  Evidence snapshot: 9 Nov 2026

Input or assumption	Value / consequence
Stereo imagery	56 left/right candidate pairs; 1024 × 1024 images
Camera model	Archive CAHV calibration; fixed stereo rig
Calibrated baseline	242.0594 units; working interpretation: millimetres
Supporting nominal baseline	240 mm in Iyer et al., LPSC 2024 abstract 1180
Timing	Typical left/right separation ~30–43 s; motion is a risk
Export units	terrain_*_m.obj is already in metres
Orientation	Nominal rover-up; gravity and global heading unverified
